T1.label: sglang-fcfs-r1-toolslow-d30w1800
T1.rule: T1 (sglang-fcfs-r1-toolslow-d30w1800) is decided alone, with no conjunction with any other cell: TRAPS iff STUCK in >= 2 of the 3 registered seeds; NO-TRAP iff GOOD in >= 2 of 3; else MIXED (a cell that meets both counts, possible only through runs that are both STUCK and GOOD, is MIXED)

T2.label: sglang-fcfs-r1-toolslow-d15-165
T2.rule: T2 (sglang-fcfs-r1-toolslow-d15-165) is decided alone, with no conjunction with any other cell: TRAPS iff STUCK in >= 2 of the 3 registered seeds; NO-TRAP iff GOOD in >= 2 of 3; else MIXED (a cell that meets both counts, possible only through runs that are both STUCK and GOOD, is MIXED)

decision.note: per cell, no conjunction: outcome is TRAPS / NO-TRAP / MIXED once no result of the missing seeds could change it, None before (and None, with outcome_if_missing_count_against None, while a seed has two counted runs); outcome_if_missing_count_against is the call if the missing seeds never come
